claim: The shared recorder, analyse, new and verify paths are 48K only (machine.py has no paging), so 128K games need their own recorder with 7FFD paging and their own verifier copy.

evidence.text: record is 48K only; a 90-line private m128.py (Machine with 7FFD paging, banks in save/load) recorded the game and replays cleanly through rzxplay.
A scripted 128K recorder was needed in the toolkit because machine.py has no paging.
The shared 48K recorder cannot save the 128K source; a private 128K recorder was reused, and a 48K-only recorder attempt failed before producing a recording.
The 128K engine carries a 128K copy of nexclash/verify.py.
The verifier's 128K paging (a flat view plus banks swapped on 7FFD) is the engine's own.
nexclash.py new stopped on a 128K snapshot (Machine has no attribute ay: the 48K-only analysis); work went on with scan, isr, preview and a trace script.

next_check: Make the recorder, analyse and verify refuse a 128K snapshot unless the engine supplies a paging model.
